conceptZh: 披風英雄想說謝謝，披風太長絆倒，一路撞倒排好的積木，倒下的積木剛好拼成「你」。
object: a caped action-figure hero with a cape three sizes too long, and a long row of standing wooden dominoes in cobalt blue
morph: a tumbling row of cobalt domino blocks lands in the strokes of the glyph 你
creativeAngle: 骨牌效應：披風英雄被自己的披風絆倒，推倒一排骨牌，運氣好地倒成「你」；詞用「謝謝你」鞠躬送禮。
promptEn: An 8-second slapstick cartoon clip on a clean solid pale peach backdrop. The only text in frame is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 你, formed from chunky cobalt-blue domino blocks and tiles, about 70% of frame height, centered with margins. Lead: a caped action-figure hero with a red cape three sizes too long that keeps flopping over his own head; one supporting object, a small gift box tied with yellow ribbon. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 你、你、謝謝你 (ㄋㄧˇ、ㄋㄧˇ、ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄝ˙ ㄋㄧˇ); the repeated 謝謝 uses the neutral tone on the second syllable; slow, clear tones, then stop. Moment 1 (0–1.8s): the hero strides in with a heroic pose, cape trailing across the floor, and as the first 你 is spoken he flicks the first standing blue domino with one finger, setting off a clack-clack chain. Moment 2 (1.8–3.6s): the cape swings up and swallows his head; blindly he wobbles in circles, his boots sliding, while the domino row snakes through the frame behind him, curving left, curling around a bend. Moment 3 (3.6–5s): on the second 你 the cape tangles his feet and he topples forward, flopping onto the last domino, which clicks into place; the whole chain tumbles in a rolling wave and settles exactly into the shape of 你, a slim slanting person-stroke on the left and a tall right part with a slanted top, a horizontal bar, and a hooked vertical with two short dashes. Moment 4 (5s): as 謝謝你 is spoken, he squirms out of the cape, bows twice, and hands over the ribbon gift box toward the glyph, a tiny star-shaped confetti puff leaping from the box. Final 5–8s: the glyph 你 stays rock still and fully readable, tiles all flat and unmoving, while the hero beside it wiggles, cape in a cheerful flutter, rocking happily on his heels without touching any tile. Gentle daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.
